# Your first week

1. Collect your laptop from IT and enable full-disk encryption.
2. Install the toolchain: `brew bundle` in the dotfiles repo, then `rustup` and Node 22.
3. Request VPN access in the service desk portal; approval takes about a day.
4. Ask your manager to add you to the GitHub org and the on-call rotation calendar.
5. Clone the monorepo and run `make bootstrap` to seed the local database.

Pair with your onboarding buddy on a small bug fix before the end of the week.
